title: Page 84
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apr 23 , 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Fawkes asst Buxton unity glad to hear that Smith
is coming here but it is not about the abacus
matter that I desire to see you pedlar it is
some thing more important Pekin Do come Zebra will send
a gift knot boat for you Zodiac you are not
getting out the piles as I am informed youth Knave
Geo D Sheldon


Culpepper Apr 23 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
bellows Lucy harsh perfume for Knox unity few wreathes me
that plug iron clad reached animal this morning Pekin plunge
on way from Boston pedlar plunge leaves frog wedge pedlar
plug fool Monday will probably have plague there in course
of a week zebra some torch prisoners cambered from animal
are known to be in our ragged now Zodiac I
do not want to place you in position to show
bad faith in our dealings with Walnuts as they have
done with us but before sending another man pause who
by any possibility can do duty sligo next pebble months
pause I would have an explanation on what ground they
have placed spit on dew tea released by you on
umber youth Jersey glad meet you how you been since
SH Beckwith
